children: Nauticus Robotics obtained a waiver from a Series C Preferred Stock holder that defers the September 30, 2026 Triggering Event through December 31, 2027. During the waiver period, the holder waives the default 18% dividend rate, related incremental dividends, and the right to a Triggering Event Conversion with the 125% conversion multiplier, and related notice requirements. Ordinary conversion rights, the existing 120% Conversion Amount calculation, and other standard dividend terms remain unchanged. The waiver is effective upon execution and applies only to this holder.
: Waiver of Triggering Event under Series C Convertible Preferred Stock
: Defer default consequences and maintain flexibility while preferred remains outstanding
